prompt: Create an ultra-realistic black-and-white lifestyle portrait of a young Black man sitting on the right side of a wide indoor windowsill beside a tabby cat, captured in a quiet, intimate moment with no text. The man has short close-cropped hair and a calm gentle expression, wearing a plain white oversized T-shirt, dark denim shorts, white low-top sneakers, a wristwatch, and a ring. He sits leaning slightly back against the window frame with his arms crossed, legs extended downward and ankles loosely crossed, looking down toward the cat with a soft smile. The cat sits upright on the left side of the sill, facing the man and looking up at him. Use a vertical portrait composition, full body visible from head to shoes, with a large industrial-style window behind them divided by dark metal mullions; outside the glass, show softly blurred apartment buildings, balconies, trees, and bright daylight. The interior is minimal, with a deep white windowsill, plain wall, smooth floor, and gentle natural window light. Style the image as a candid documentary fashion photograph, high-resolution monochrome, realistic skin texture, soft contrast, shallow depth of field, peaceful atmosphere, quiet companionship, no props beyond the watch and ring, no watermark, no captions.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的黑白生活风人像，画面中 一名年轻的黑人男性 坐在宽大的室内窗台右侧，旁边是 一只虎斑猫，捕捉一个安静、亲密的瞬间，画面中无文字。该男子留着短寸发型，表情平静温柔，身穿 一件纯白色廓形 T 恤、深色牛仔短裤、白色低帮运动鞋，佩戴手表和戒指。他身体微微后仰靠在窗框上，双臂交叉，双腿向下伸展，脚踝自然交叉，低头看向猫咪，嘴角带着柔和的微笑。猫咪坐在窗台左侧，面向男子并抬头注视着他。采用竖构图，全身可见，从头部到鞋子均在画面内；身后是一扇由深色金属窗棂分隔的大型工业风窗户；窗外呈现出柔和模糊的公寓楼、阳台、树木和明亮的日光。室内风格简约，配有深白色窗台、素色墙面、平滑地板，以及柔和的自然窗光。图片风格为纪实时尚摄影，高分辨率黑白影像，真实的皮肤纹理，柔和的对比度，浅景深，营造宁静的氛围与静谧的陪伴感，除手表和戒指外无其他道具，无水印，无标题。
